meta_description: R Boardman Decorating in Sheffield offers professional interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and decorating. Free quotes, reliable service.
hero_subhead: From tired walls to stunning interiors. We transform your Sheffield home with precision, care, and fair pricing.
services_subhead: Whether you need interior refresh, exterior weatherproofing, or specialist finishes, we've got the skills and materials to do it right.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Walls, ceilings, woodwork, and feature walls in your choice of finish. We prep thoroughly, paint carefully, and leave no mess behind.

services.title: Wallpapering & Wall Coverings
services.desc: Bespoke wallpaper hanging, feature walls, and contemporary wall coverings. Pattern-matched and perfectly executed every time.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Masonry
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior paint for rendered walls, brickwork, and soffits. Protects your home and refreshes its street appeal.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Finishing
services.desc: Doors, skirting boards, frames, and garden structures painted to a professional finish with premium paint that lasts.

services.title: Damp & Stain Treatment
services.desc: Specialist primers and treatments for water stains, damp patches, and challenging surfaces — including guaranteed coverage.

services.title: Commercial & Retail Decoration
services.desc: Shop fronts, offices, and communal areas painted efficiently and to schedule. Minimise disruption with our flexible working approach.

about_pullquote: I do the job as if I'm decorating my own home — careful, honest, on time.
about_para_1: R Boardman Decorating has served Sheffield and Rotherham homeowners for over 20 years. We started with one simple idea: deliver professional painting and decorating without the premium price tag or the nonsense. Every job — from a single bedroom to a full commercial refit — gets the same attention to detail and respect for your time and budget.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us because we listen, we turn up when we say we will, and we stand behind our work. We've built our reputation one satisfied homeowner at a time. References are available on request, and we're happy to show you examples of recent work in your neighbourhood.
reviews_heading: What Sheffield Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Ring called up on a Saturday to ask if we could fit in a small job before Christmas. Roy came out, quoted fair, and was there the following Monday. Painted our hall, stairs and landing in two days — not a spec of paint on the carpets. Very tidy, hardworking bloke. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had our living room and kitchen walls done. Was a bit nervous after a bad experience with a decorator a few years back, but Rod was completely professional. Good communication, stuck to the quote, and the finish is brilliant. Will definitely call him again for the bedrooms.
reviews.author: Emma L.

reviews.text: Needed wallpaper hung in our hallway — it's got a tricky feature wall and we were worried it wouldn't be done right. Roy measured everything, sourced the paper, and hung it perfectly. Looks amazing. No stress, fair price, job done.
reviews.author: Paul J.
